# Annotated radar regression observations

`annotated_shots.json` contains the seven operator-labelled Space-to-Space captures
from recording `1793296169926267431-24640`. It preserves original point coordinates,
radial velocities, SNR and frame numbers, with no client address or free-text notes.
The sensor model is copied from the uploaded radar configuration.

Each point is `[X, Y, Z, radial_velocity, SNR-or-null, independent_ball_return]`.
The final flag is a manually identified return from the coherent outgoing velocity
band / late ball tail inspected in the original logs. Labels are supplied separately
in `ball_returns.json`; they are not generated by the detector under test. Unresolved
early club/ball coincidences are not labelled as independently identifiable balls.

The regression runs the original observations, observations with those independent
ball returns withheld, and ball-only observations. The withheld-return case is a
counterfactual club/noise-only test, not an independently recorded dry swing.
Dedicated real dry-swing recordings are still needed to measure false-positive rate.

Rebuild from the unchanged source recording with:

```bash
python3 tools/analyze_live_session.py \
  radar_app/logs/radar-live/1793296169926267431-24640 --captures --summary-only \
  --ball-labels radar_app/tests/fixtures/ball_returns.json \
  --fixture-out radar_app/tests/fixtures/annotated_shots.json
```

Frame and velocity bands here are test-data annotations only. Production tracking
uses sensor uncertainties and observed motion; it does not contain these labels,
coordinates, frame numbers or speed bands.
